page_title: ENG 1-2 FRA | England v France 10/12/2022, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+11' Wilton Sampaio is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+11' A decent effort by Marcus Rashford (England) from a close-range free kick! His attempt flies narrowly over the crossbar.
90+9' Wilton Sampaio blows his whistle for a foul after Kingsley Coman (France) hacks down one of his opponents. England are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
90+8' Gareth Southgate is forced to make a change. John Stones is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Jack Grealish (England).
90+6' John Stones (England) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
90+5' Luke Shaw (England) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Hugo Lloris, who smothers the ball.
90+3' Raheem Sterling (England) sends a long ball in, but Hugo Lloris comfortably gathers the ball.
90+2' Luke Shaw (England) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
90+2' Luke Shaw (England) sends a cross into the box, but Hugo Lloris comes off his line to gather the ball. England have a corner.
90' We will have 8 min. of added time.
90' Mason Mount (England) commits a rough challenge and Wilton Sampaio blows his whistle for an infringement.
90' The game has begun to heat up. Harry Maguire (England) challenges an opponent and receives a deserved yellow card for his ugly tackle.

89' Mason Mount (England) receives an accurate pass and attempts to threaten the goalkeeper with his long-range strike. Unfortunately for him, his effort goes high above the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for France.
87' Adrien Rabiot (France) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.

87' Olivier Giroud (France) commits a foul on his opponent and it looks like it should be the other way around at first glance, but the referee makes the right decision in awarding a free kick to the other team.
86' Jude Bellingham (England) is penalised for a foul. Wilton Sampaio had a clear view and blows his whistle.
85' Substitution. Phil Foden did his best and is replaced by Marcus Rashford (England).
84' Harry Kane (England) can't convert the spot kick. It goes narrowly over the crossbar.
83' Harry Kane (England) is going to take the penalty!
82' Theo Hernandez (France) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Wilton Sampaio ignores the protests.
82' The England players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
81' Referee Wilton Sampaio makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for England. Let’s see what happens!
80' PENALTY APPEAL after Mason Mount (England) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
79' Here comes a substitution. Ousmane Dembele is given a rest as he is replaced by Kingsley Coman (France).
79' Substitution. Bukayo Saka walks off the pitch and Raheem Sterling (England) comes on as a substitute.
79' Gareth Southgate decides to make a substitution. Jordan Henderson will be replaced by Mason Mount (England).

78' 1 - 2 It's a goal! Olivier Giroud (France) bursts into the box to get on the end of a whipped in cross from Antoine Griezmann and scores magnificently from close range into the left side of the goal. 1:2.
77' The resulting corner from Antoine Griezmann (France) is cleared by the opposition's defence.

77' A pass into the box finds Olivier Giroud (France) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the middle of the goal, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Jordan Pickford denies him. The ball is out of play. France will have a chance to score from a corner.
76' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Luke Shaw (England).
76' The attendance for today's match is 68895.
75' A flowing move ends with a great cross into the centre of the box, which Olivier Giroud (France) latches onto but sends a wild header well wide of the right post.
75' Ousmane Dembele (France) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
74' Jude Bellingham (England) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
73' The referee blows his whistle for a foul after Bukayo Saka (England) overruns the ball during an attack and makes an aggressive challenge on his opponent.
72' Antoine Griezmann (France) is adjudged offside.
72' Wilton Sampaio blows his whistle and it's Bukayo Saka (England) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.

70' Harry Maguire (England) shows good awareness inside the box as he latches on to a cross from the resulting free kick. He jumps high but his towering header lacks a little bit of accuracy and glances off the left-hand post.
69' Wilton Sampaio interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Theo Hernandez (France).
65' Jude Bellingham (England) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul.
64' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Ousmane Dembele (France) but poses no threat.
64' Jordan Henderson (England) commits a rough challenge and Wilton Sampaio blows his whistle for a foul.

62' Harry Kane (England) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the bottom right corner. Hugo Lloris pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
61' Ousmane Dembele (France) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
60' What an amazing save by Hugo Lloris! Bukayo Saka (England) swirls around the defenders and attempts to beat the keeper with a close-range shot low towards the middle of the target, but fails.

55' Adrien Rabiot (France) picks the ball up and blasts it from long range without any hesitation. His shot is directed towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper reads it well and makes a fine save.
54' 1 - 1 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Harry Kane (England) into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Hugo Lloris no chance!
53' Harry Kane (England) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
52' Aurelien Tchouameni (France) tackles a bit over-zealously and Wilton Sampaio blows for a foul. The referee points to the penalty spot. England are awarded a penalty kick!
52' Bukayo Saka (England) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
50' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Olivier Giroud (France) heads on.
50' Antoine Griezmann (France) takes the free kick from a long way out but the defender manages to get it clear.
49' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Jordan Henderson (England). Wilton Sampaio saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
49' Bukayo Saka (England) brings his opponent down. Wilton Sampaio has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.

48' Harry Maguire (England) is first to react to a whipped in corner and flashes a header in on goal from close range, but one of his teammates inadvertently blocks the ball and stops him scoring. No wonder he's upset!
48' Phil Foden (England) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.

47' Jude Bellingham (England) meets a delivery on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the top of the net. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Hugo Lloris produces an easy save. The referee blows his whistle, England are awarded a corner kick.
47' Phil Foden (England) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
46' Ousmane Dembele (France) has tested the patience of referee Wilton Sampaio and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+5' The match has reached half-time.
45+3' Phil Foden (England) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates as he overhits the effort.
45+3' Olivier Giroud (France) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
45' Jude Bellingham (England) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
43' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Antoine Griezmann (France) was quite harsh and Wilton Sampaio didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
41' Ousmane Dembele (France) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
41' Harry Kane (England) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear.
39' A short pass from Theo Hernandez puts Kylian Mbappe (France) in the clear inside the box with just the keeper to beat, but his shot sails high over the bar.
39' Wilton Sampaio blows his whistle after Jordan Henderson (England) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
38' Jordan Henderson (England) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
36' Antoine Griezmann (France) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
35' Antoine Griezmann (France) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
33' Antoine Griezmann (France) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Wilton Sampaio blows his whistle for a foul.
32' Adrien Rabiot (France) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Wilton Sampaio who sees an offensive foul.
29' Phil Foden (England) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.

29' Harry Kane (England) meets a delivery on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the top right corner. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Hugo Lloris pulls off an easy save. The ball goes out for a corner. England can continue in their attacking effort.
29' Bukayo Saka (England) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away.
27' Here’s the VAR verdict on that penalty incident – NO PENALTY for England! Play can continue.

26' Play continues despite the shouts by some England players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Wilton Sampaio interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
25' Harry Kane (England) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
22' Harry Kane (England) receives a great pass inside the box and misses a golden chance. The goalkeeper pulls off a stunning save.
20' Luke Shaw (England) releases a promising shot from the free kick on the edge of the box. His effort towards the middle of the goal is comfortably saved by Hugo Lloris.
19' Adrien Rabiot (France) trips an opposition player and Wilton Sampaio signals a foul. Another situation results in a direct free kick for England.

17' 0 - 1 Antoine Griezmann slides a pass towards Aurelien Tchouameni (France) who unleashes a fabulous shot from long range. The ball goes behind the surprised goalkeeper and into the bottom left corner. The score is now 0:1.

15' Kylian Mbappe (France) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. The ball goes out of play and England will have a goal kick.
11' Jordan Pickford pulls off a fine save! Olivier Giroud (France) attempts to head home after a precise cross into the box. He aims his header low towards the middle, but the effort is kept out.
10' Antoine Griezmann (France) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
10' Antoine Griezmann (France) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. France get a corner.
9' Ousmane Dembele (France) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
8' Harry Maguire (England) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.
7' Kylian Mbappe (France) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.

6' A cross from the free kick is whipped in by Luke Shaw (England), but one of the defenders steps in and averts the threat. Harry Maguire (England) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
5' Wilton Sampaio couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Ousmane Dembele (France) and blew his whistle.
4' Phil Foden (England) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
3' Harry Kane (England) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
3' Some neat passing and movement from France as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
